airtableFormula.mcp.autoConfigureOnInsta.description: Automatically configure MCP in detected IDEs on first launch.

airtableFormula.mcp.serverPathOverride.description: Override bundled MCP server path. Leave empty to use bundled.

airtableFormula.mcp.notifyOnUpdates.description: Show notification when MCP server updates are available.

airtableFormula.mcp.useDaemon.description: Start and use a shared daemon process for MCP server. Disable to use a direct per-session process (legacy behavior).

airtableFormula.mcp.daemonPort.description: Fixed TCP port for the shared MCP daemon's HTTP server. Defaults to 8723 so the daemon keeps the same port across restarts (stable MCP client config, predictable process to find/kill). Change it to any free port, or set 0 for an automatic OS-assigned port. Takes effect on the next daemon restart; if the chosen port is already in use, the daemon falls back to an automatic port.

enumDescriptions: Log in through a bundled headless Chrome, then run all API calls over direct HTTP (default). The browser only mints/refreshes the session cookie.
Bring your own cookie — no browser. Paste a session cookie into ~/.airtable-user-mcp/credentials.json (or set the AIRTABLE_COOKIE env var); the CSRF token is scraped automatically.
Browser-free login via email + password + TOTP. Set them in ~/.airtable-user-mcp/login.json (or AIRTABLE_EMAIL / AIRTABLE_PASSWORD / AIRTABLE_TOTP_SECRET). SSO/Google accounts must use 'browser'.
airtableFormula.mcp.authMode.description: How the MCP server authenticates to Airtable's internal API. All modes send API calls over direct HTTP; only 'browser' launches Chrome (for login). 'byo' and 'direct-login' run with no browser at all. Takes effect on the next daemon/server restart.

enumDescriptions: Node's built-in fetch (default) — verified to work against Airtable's internal API with no TLS impersonation.
impit with Chrome TLS impersonation — a fallback if Airtable ever fingerprints non-browser clients. Requires the optional 'impit' package to be available to the server.
airtableFormula.mcp.httpClient.description: HTTP client for direct Airtable API calls. Leave as 'fetch' unless requests start getting blocked; 'impit' impersonates Chrome's TLS fingerprint. Takes effect on the next daemon/server restart.

airtableFormula.mcp.browserIdleParkMinut.description: Minutes of idle time before the shared daemon parks (closes) its Chromium browser to free ~300–600 MB RSS. Cookie-based HTTP keeps working; the browser is only relaunched if session recovery needs it. Set 0 to disable. Takes effect on the next daemon/server restart.

enumDescriptions: Use the MCP server bundled with the extension (default)
Use npx to run airtable-user-mcp from npm (version-independent)
airtableFormula.mcp.serverSource.description: How the MCP server is launched for external IDEs.

airtableFormula.ai.autoInstallFiles.description: Automatically install AI skills/rules/workflows on first launch.

airtableFormula.ai.includeAgents.description: Install agent config files where the IDE supports them.

airtableFormula.formula.defaultBeautifyS.description: Default beautify style (readable, compact, smart, etc.).

airtableFormula.auth.autoRefresh.description: Automatically check and refresh Airtable session on a schedule.

airtableFormula.auth.refreshIntervalHour.description: Hours between automatic session health checks (1–168).

airtableFormula.auth.loginMode.description: Login mode: 'manual' opens a browser for you to log in, 'auto' uses stored credentials for automated login.

airtableFormula.auth.browserChoice.description: Browser selection for authentication. Set via the dashboard UI.

enumDescriptions: Schema inspection, formula validation, and record reading only (10 tools)
Read + record read/write + create/update tables, fields, views, sidebar sections, and record templates, no deletes, no form metadata (54 tools)
All tools enabled including destructive ops, form metadata, extensions, and daemon control (72 tools)
User-defined per-tool selection
airtableFormula.mcp.toolProfile.description: Active MCP tool profile. Controls which tools are exposed to AI agents through the bundled Airtable MCP server.

airtableFormula.mcp.categories.read.description: Read / Inspect tools: get_base_schema, list_tables, get_table_schema, list_fields, list_views, get_view, validate_formula, list_view_sections.

airtableFormula.mcp.categories.tableWrit.description: Table Write tools: create_table, rename_table, create_record_template, rename_record_template, update_record_template_description, set_record_template_cell, set_record_template_visible_columns, duplicate_record_template, apply_record_template.

airtableFormula.mcp.categories.fieldWrit.description: Field Write tools: create_field, create_formula_field, update_field_config, update_formula_field, rename_field, update_field_description, duplicate_field.

airtableFormula.mcp.categories.viewWrite.description: View Write tools: create_view, duplicate_view, rename_view, update_view_description, update_view_filters, reorder_view_fields, show_or_hide_view_columns, apply_view_sorts, update_view_group_levels, update_view_row_height, set_view_columns, show_or_hide_all_columns, move_visible_columns, move_overall_columns, update_frozen_column_count, set_view_cover, set_view_color_config, set_view_cell_wrap, set_calendar_date_columns.

airtableFormula.mcp.categories.viewSecti.description: View Section tools (sidebar grouping, non-destructive): create_view_section, rename_view_section, move_view_to_section.
View Section destructive tool: delete_view_section. Views inside a deleted section are auto-promoted to ungrouped (Airtable behavior).

airtableFormula.mcp.categories.formWrite.description: Form metadata tools (legacy form views — public-facing artifacts gated separately from view-write): set_form_metadata, set_form_submission_notification.

airtableFormula.mcp.categories.extension.description: Extension Management tools: create_extension, create_extension_dashboard, install_extension, update_extension_state, rename_extension, duplicate_extension, remove_extension.

airtableFormula.mcp.categories.recordRea.description: Record Read tool: query_records (snapshot read via readQueries, up to 1000 rows per call).

airtableFormula.mcp.categories.recordWri.description: Record Write tools: create_records, update_records, duplicate_records, upload_attachment (bulk record create/update/duplication and URL-based attachment uploads).

airtableFormula.mcp.categories.recordDes.description: Record Destructive tools: delete_records (batch record deletion).

airtableFormula.mcp.categories.sync.description: Sync tools: sync_base (base-to-base schema + record sync). mode=plan/diff/status are read-only; mode=apply mutates the destination and, with policy=mirror plus the confirmation flags, can delete tables, fields, views, sections and records; mode=reconcile updates local mapping state.

airtableFormula.mcp.categories.daemon.description: Daemon Control tool: manage_daemon (inspect and administer the MCP daemon itself — not Airtable). action=status is read-only and reports daemon liveness, transport, uptime, tunnel URL and the live session/browser state; start, restart, stop, tunnel_enable, tunnel_disable and token_rotate control the running process. Off by default: this lets an AI agent stop or restart the server it is talking through.

airtableFormula.mcp.categories.localWrit.description: Local File Write tools: download_formula_field, download_base_formulas. These READ from Airtable but WRITE .formula files to a path the caller chooses, so they are not part of the read-only profile. Included in safe-write and full.

airtableFormula.mcp.tools.description: Per-tool enable/disable overrides (only used in 'custom' profile). Keys are tool names, values are booleans.

airtableFormula.debug.enabled.description: Enable debug event collection for both extension and MCP server. Events are buffered in memory and only written to disk on export.

airtableFormula.debug.bufferSize.description: Maximum number of debug events to keep in the ring buffer.

airtableFormula.debug.verboseHttp.description: Include HTTP request/response events from the MCP server (high volume).

enumDescriptions: Prettier defaults: 2-space indent, double quotes, trailing commas
printWidth: 120, no trailing commas
singleQuote: true
useTabs: true
semi: false
airtableFormula.script.beautifyStyle.description: Default beautify style for Airtable Script and Automation formatters.

enumDescriptions: Whitespace removal only — no mangle, no compress
compress: true, mangle: false (good balance)
compress: true, mangle: true (safe for Airtable scripts — field/table names are string literals)
Aggressive + passes: 2, unsafe compress options
airtableFormula.script.minifyLevel.description: Default minify level for Airtable Script and Automation minifier.

airtableFormula.script.terser.mangle.description: Enable Terser identifier mangling in aggressive/extreme levels.

mcpServerDefinitionProviders.label: Airtable User MCP
mcpServerDefinitionProviders.description: Manage Airtable bases via 72 MCP tools: schema read, table CRUD, field CRUD (including formula/rollup/lookup/download), view configuration (filters / sorts / groups / visibility / column ordering / freezing — with merge-safe append mode), sidebar section grouping, view-type metadata (Kanban/Gallery/Calendar covers, colors, calendar date ranges), legacy-form metadata, formula validation, formula download, bulk base formula download, record template management (create / rename / pre-fill cells / duplicate / apply / delete), record CRUD (create / update / delete / duplicate / upload_attachment), extension management, base-to-base sync, and daemon control. Operates over stdio using JSON-RPC 2.0.
